title: Proposal: Improve accessibility
body:
> Discussion on: https://paper.dropbox.com/doc/InstantSearch-accessibility--AIdRtTIt19VrHIG4OABe31KPAg-RaDyCmcTvKpi8JShVD5sY Accessibility is an important topic and we should be responsible for it as we generate the DOM for our users. Accessibility is UX. We should raise awareness, include this concept in our workflow and respect standards. I went through all widgets and took notes of accessibility improvements we need to address in the next InstantSearch versions implementing InstantSearch.css. I added sources to back up the proposed changes. Let's discuss about them - feel free to add more suggestions. If you agree with this new markup, I will create a PR. ## Breadcrumb * Use `nav` with `aria-label="Breadcrumb"` * Use ordered list (`ol`) * Add `aria-current="page"` to active element ### Template ```html
  1. Home
  2. > Cooking
  3. > Kitchen textiles
``` ### Sources * https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-practices/examples/breadcrumb/index.html * http://a11y-style-guide.com/style-guide/section-navigation.html#kssref-navigation-pagination ## CurrentRefinements * Use new list for category refinements ### Template ```html
  • Category:
    • Movies & TV Shows
    • Others
``` ## Highlight * Use `mark` ### Template ```html This is the highlighted text ``` ### Sources * https://www.w3schools.com/tags/tag\_mark.asp ## Pagination * Use `nav` * Add `aria-label="Pagination"` * Use ordered list (`ol`) * Add `aria-current="page"` to active element ### Template ```html
  1. ‹‹
  2. ‹
  3. 1
  4. 2
  5. 3
  6. 4
  7. ›
  8. ››
``` ### Sources * http://a11y-style-guide.com/style-guide/section-navigation.html#kssref-navigation-pagination * https://tink.uk/using-the-aria-current-attribute/ ## Panel * Use `header` for the header * Use `footer` for the footer ### Template ```html
Header
Panel content
Footer
``` ### Sources * https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/header * https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/footer ## RefinementList * Use ordered list (`ol`) because it can be searchable ### Template ```html
``` ## Snippet * Use `mark` ### Template ```html This is the snippet text ``` ### Sources * https://www.w3schools.com/tags/tag\_mark.asp
